videos.name: overview
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | SO-101 and SO-102: Before and After
videos.description:
Recorded before-and-after tests of SO-101 and SO-102 arms using STS32XX custom servo firmware. Each model is shown with its original behavior first, then with the custom-firmware setup. Approximate values describe these specific demonstrations, not guaranteed accuracy across the workspace.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: repeatability
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | Repeatability: Repeated Returns
videos.description:
Repeated returns measured with an indicator. Repeatability describes consistency across repeated moves; it is different from absolute positioning accuracy. This recorded demonstration does not establish accuracy across the full workspace.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: repeatability-vs-accuracy
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | Repeatability vs Absolute Positioning Accuracy
videos.description:
A conceptual explanation of repeatability and absolute positioning accuracy. Repeatability describes how consistently the arm returns; absolute positioning accuracy describes how close it gets to the commanded target. The graphics are explanatory, not measured hardware plots.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: stock-pid-oscillation
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | Stock Firmware: PID Tuning and Oscillation
videos.description:
Recorded oscillation during PID tuning on stock servo firmware. In some test scenarios, settings that reduced positioning error also caused oscillation. This motivated additional control over motion planning and position feedback.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: s-curve
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | S-Curve Motion Profiles
videos.description:
A conceptual explanation of gradual acceleration and braking. Each servo plans its own jerk-limited motion locally. Short moves may omit stages. The animation is explanatory, not a measured hardware plot.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: pid-tuning
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | PID Position Control
videos.description:
A conceptual explanation of configurable position control. Proportional, integral and derivative contributions affect correction, settling and damping. The curves are illustrative; gains must be tuned for the actual mechanism and load.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: velocity-feedforward
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | Local Velocity Feedforward
videos.description:
A conceptual explanation of velocity feedforward. Each servo calculates additional motor output from its planned speed using configured direction-specific gains. Feedforward falls to zero when planned motion stops. The animation is not a measured hardware plot.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: gravity-compensation
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | Host-Calculated Gravity Compensation
videos.description:
A conceptual explanation of gravity compensation. The host calculates the contribution for the arm pose and load; the servo applies it subject to slew and output limits. The servo does not contain an arm model. The animation is explanatory, not measured data.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.

Firmware, setup guide and detailed documentation:
https://github.com/roboninecom/STS32XX-Firmware

videos.name: mechanical-limits
videos.title: STS32XX Firmware | Mechanical Limits: Backlash and Frame Flex
videos.description:
Gearbox backlash and frame flex can affect endpoint position even with improved control. Controller tuning does not eliminate these mechanical limitations. This clip combines mechanism footage with a conceptual explanation of frame flex.

Silent documentation clip from Robonine.
